audience: Greek businesses and their accountants that issue e-invoices and run hosted websites with Play Systems

useCases.title: Review the e-invoices issued for a VAT number
useCases.text: List the e-invoices of an issuer VAT number, with an optional invoice type and date range. Open one invoice to read its lines, totals and status.

useCases.title: Check the payments recorded on an e-invoice
useCases.text: Find the invoice by its 15-digit MARK. Then list the payments recorded against that invoice.

useCases.title: Check the web usage of a hosting package
useCases.text: Read the plan, status and limits of a hosting package. Then read its bandwidth, disk, database and mail counts.

useCases.title: Review the DNS records of a domain
useCases.text: Read the name, expiry and status of a domain on a hosting package. Then read its DNS records and the suggested nameservers.

useCases.title: Check whether a domain name is available
useCases.text: Search a domain name or prefix to see if it is available, with its price and expiry. The server does not order or renew domains.
